arguments.sql:
WITH ranked_frame_versions AS (
    SELECT cards.frameVersion,
           COUNT(*) AS card_count,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (
               ORDER BY CASE cards.frameVersion
                   WHEN 'future' THEN 2007
                   ELSE CAST(cards.frameVersion AS INTEGER)
               END DESC
           ) AS version_rank
    FROM cards
    WHERE cards.frameVersion IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cards.frameVersion
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN cards.convertedManaCost = 0 THEN 1 END) > 0
)
SELECT frameVersion, card_count
FROM ranked_frame_versions
WHERE version_rank = 1
ORDER BY frameVersion
LIMIT -1
